law: concat of one tensor is the tensor (TASO cat-noop).

law: concat is associative: cat(cat(a,b),c) = cat(a,b,c) — the n-ary flatten (TASO concat associativity; the KV-cache append chain).

law: concat(a, cat(b,c)) = cat(a,b,c) — right-nested flatten.

law: The 3-way split/merge round-trip.

law: cat(split0(u), split1(u)) = u — the uneven split's round-trip (two sizes cover the axis).

law: cat(unsqueeze(a,d), unsqueeze(b,d), d) = stack(a,b,d) — torch.stack IS the cat of the unsqueezed pair.

law: cat(abs(a), abs(b)) = abs(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).

law: cat(relu(a), relu(b)) = relu(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).

law: cat(sigmoid(a), sigmoid(b)) = sigmoid(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).

law: cat(silu(a), silu(b)) = silu(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).

law: cat(tanh(a), tanh(b)) = tanh(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).
name: concat_pull_tanh

law: cat(gelu(a), gelu(b)) = gelu(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).
name: concat_pull_gelu

law: cat(exp(a), exp(b)) = exp(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).

law: cat(square(a), square(b)) = square(cat(a,b)) — the pointwise op commutes with the partition (TASO concat-pointwise).
name: concat_pull_square

law: cat(add(a1,b1), add(a2,b2)) = add(cat(a1,a2), cat(b1,b2)) — the pointwise pair commutes with the partition.
name: concat_pull_add

law: cat(mul(a1,b1), mul(a2,b2)) = mul(cat(a1,a2), cat(b1,b2)) — the pointwise pair commutes with the partition.
name: concat_pull_mul

law: cat(sub(a1,b1), sub(a2,b2)) = sub(cat(a1,a2), cat(b1,b2)) — the pointwise pair commutes with the partition.
name: concat_pull_sub

law: cat(a@W, b@W) = cat(a,b)@W on a non-contraction axis — row/batch blocks of a shared contraction merge into one matmul (TASO matmul-concat).

law: Reverse: split a matmul's non-contraction axis into two products (eqsat weighs split vs merged).
name: mm_concat_left_rev

law: cat(x@b, x@c) = x@cat(b,c) along the output axis — column blocks of a shared input merge into one matmul.
name: mm_concat_right

law: Reverse column-block split (eqsat weighs both forms).
name: mm_concat_right_rev

law: (cat(a,b,-1)) @ W = a@W_top + b@W_bot — the split-K decomposition: the contraction axis partitions, the weight splits on its -2 axis (TASO).

law: The split-K refold — the two partial products merge into one contraction.
name: mm_splitk_rev

law: cat(xAᵀ, xBᵀ) = x[A;B]ᵀ on the output axis — the MergedColumnParallelLinear merge (TASO).

law: Reverse: split a fused projection into per-block linears.
name: linear_concat_w_rev

law: xWᵀ + b = linear(x, W, b) — the bias epilogue folds into the GEMM (Inductor's addmm; TASO's matmul+bias).

law: The operand-swapped bias-epilogue fold.

law: Reverse: expose the fused bias as a pointwise epilogue (eqsat weighs fused vs spelled).

law: linear(x,A,b1) + linear(x,B,b2) = linear(x, A+B, b1+b2) — the affine-map weight merge (model-soup / LoRA-merge class).

law: cat(conv(x,W1), conv(x,W2)) = conv(x, cat(W1,W2,0)) on the channel axis — same-geometry convs merge into one (TASO's conv-merge; the Inception parallel fold).

law: cat(conv(x,W1), conv(x,W2)) = conv(x, cat(W1,W2,0)) on the channel axis — same-geometry convs merge into one (TASO's conv-merge; the Inception parallel fold).

law: cat(conv(x,W1), conv(x,W2)) = conv(x, cat(W1,W2,0)) on the channel axis — same-geometry convs merge into one (TASO's conv-merge; the Inception parallel fold).
name: conv_out_merge_sp

law: cat(conv(x,W1), conv(x,W2)) = conv(x, cat(W1,W2,0)) on the channel axis — same-geometry convs merge into one (TASO's conv-merge; the Inception parallel fold).
name: conv_out_merge_sp_nobias

law: cat(conv(x,W1), conv(x,W2)) = conv(x, cat(W1,W2,0)) on the channel axis — same-geometry convs merge into one (TASO's conv-merge; the Inception parallel fold).
name: conv_out_merge_spdg

law: cat(conv(x,W1), conv(x,W2)) = conv(x, cat(W1,W2,0)) on the channel axis — same-geometry convs merge into one (TASO's conv-merge; the Inception parallel fold).
name: conv_out_merge_spdg_nobias

law: add commutes with select — the select_mul guard: same index on the same axis and a denoting broadcast grid.
name: select_add

law: sub commutes with select — the select_mul guard: same index on the same axis and a denoting broadcast grid.
name: select_sub

law: div commutes with select — the select_mul guard: same index on the same axis and a denoting broadcast grid.
name: select_div

law: unbind(u, d)[i] IS select(u, d, i) — the exported unbind carries its picked index (the getitem-folded spelling).
name: unbind_select

law: select(u, d, i) = squeeze(slice(u, d, i, i+1), d) — the unit-width slice spelling of an index pick.
name: select_to_slice

law: slice(u, d, i, i+1) = unsqueeze(select(u, d, i), d) — the one-element slice is the re-widened index pick.
name: slice_to_select

law: unsq(u·v, d) = unsq(u, d)·unsq(v, d) — the size-1-axis insert distributes over elementwise mul: XLA's broadcast-sink direction, guarded to the flat-map-unsq region AND UD literal-in-range for both operand unsqs (the implicit-broadcast soundness envelope).
name: mul_unsq_rev

law: contiguous(x) is a value-identity relayout — the IR's semantics is value-level, so the strip is exact.
name: contiguous_id

law: clone(x) preserves values exactly — a materialization, not a value change.
name: clone_id

law: alias(x) is the identity leaf-relabel.
name: alias_id

law: detach(x) is the value identity — the autograd boundary the IR does not model (Inductor strips it in inference).
name: detach_id

law: detach_(x) — the in-place spelling of the same value identity.
name: detach_inplace_id

law: float(float(x)) = float(x) — dtype casts are idempotent.
name: float_idem

law: half(half(x)) = half(x) — dtype casts are idempotent.
name: half_idem

law: double(double(x)) = double(x) — dtype casts are idempotent.
name: double_idem

law: bfloat16(bfloat16(x)) = bfloat16(x) — dtype casts are idempotent.
name: bfloat16_idem

law: squeeze(unsqueeze(u, d), d) = u — the insert/remove pair cancels on the same normalized axis.
name: unsqueeze_squeeze

law: unsqueeze(squeeze(u, d), d) = u when u[d] == 1 — the remove/insert pair cancels on a size-1 axis only.
name: squeeze_unsqueeze

law: squeeze(u, d) on a non-1 axis removes nothing — a no-op the exporter's belt-and-braces squeezes leave behind.
name: squeeze_noop

law: reshape(u, shape(u)) = u — the no-op reshape strip (Inductor view-chain simplification).
name: reshape_noop

law: reshape(reshape(u, s0), s1) = reshape(u, s1) — view composition keeps only the final target.
name: reshape_reshape

law: broadcast_to(u, shape(u)) = u — the same no-op for the materializing spelling.
name: broadcast_to_noop

law: broadcast_to(u, s) = expand(u, s) — the strict spelling is a special case of the view.
name: broadcast_to_expand

law: slice(u, d, 0, e) = u when e >= u[d] — the full-cover slice strip (the export's ``x[..., :e]`` no-op).
name: slice_noop

law: The start-elided full-cover slice — ``x[..., :e]`` with e >= u[d].
name: slice_noop_nostart

law: index_select(u, d, range(u[d])) = u — the identity gather.
name: index_select_id

law: roll(u, shifts=0) = u — a zero shift on every axis.
name: roll_noop

law: pad(u, zeros) = u — an all-zero pad pad is a no-op.
name: pad_noop

law: repeat(u, ones) = u — tiling by 1 on every axis.
name: repeat_noop

law: permute(u, identity) = u.
name: permute_noop

law: permute(permute(u,P),Q) = permute(u, P∘Q) — permutation composition, minted as gather(P, Q).
name: permute_compose

law: movedim(movedim(u,s,d),d,s) = u — moving an axis forth and back is the identity.
name: movedim_involution

law: flatten(u, i, i) = u — a one-axis merge is a no-op.
name: flatten_noop

law: unflatten(u, d, (u[d],)) = u — a singleton split restores the same axis.
name: unflatten_noop

law: split(u, (u[d],), d, 0) = u — a one-section split is the whole tensor (the chunk_single sibling).
name: split_single

law: flip(flip(u, d), d) = u — reversing the same axes twice.
name: flip_involution

law: tril(tril(u, g), g) = tril(u, g) — masking is idempotent.
name: tril_idem

law: triu(triu(u, g), g) = triu(u, g).
name: triu_idem

law: clamp(clamp(u,l,h),l,h) = clamp(u,l,h) — same-bound nesting is a no-op.
name: clamp_idem

law: std = sqrt(var) — the same dims/correction/keepdim on both sides (XLA's std decomposition).
name: std_sqrt_var

law: var = std² — the reverse spelling.
name: var_square_std

law: The whole-tensor spelling — std() = sqrt(var()).
name: std_sqrt_var_bare

law: The whole-tensor var = std².
name: var_square_std_bare

law: ‖u‖₂ = sqrt(Σ u²) — the L2 norm's spelled work (XLA linalg decomposition).
name: norm2_expand

law: sqrt(Σ u²) folds to the L2 kernel.
name: norm2_fold

law: log(softmax(u, d)) = log_softmax(u, d) — the fused log-softmax fold (softcap/logprob heads).
name: log_softmax_fold

law: exp(log_softmax(u, d)) = softmax(u, d) — the same kernel pair the other way.
name: log_softmax_expand

law: σ(x) = 1/(1+e⁻ˣ) — the definition, expanded so pointwise laws see the interior (Inductor decomp).
name: sigmoid_expand

law: 1/(1+e⁻ˣ) folds to σ(x) — the manual-spelling fold (softmax_fold's sibling one kernel over).
name: sigmoid_fold

law: The div-spelled 1/(1+e⁻ˣ) folds to σ(x).
name: sigmoid_fold_div

law: tanh(x) = 2σ(2x) − 1 — the sigmoid-based decomposition (the TASO/XLA tanh spelling).
name: tanh_expand

law: 2σ(2x) − 1 folds to tanh(x).
name: tanh_fold

law: gelu(x) = 0.5x(1 + erf(x/√2)) — the exact erf definition (aten's default gelu; the tanh approximation is a DIFFERENT op under this bank and is not claimed).
name: gelu_expand

law: mish(x) = x·tanh(softplus(x)) — the Mish definition.
name: mish_expand

law: hardsigmoid(x) = relu6(x+3)/6 — the piecewise-linear approximation's definition.
name: hardsigmoid_expand

law: relu6(x+3)/6 folds to hardsigmoid(x).
name: hardsigmoid_fold

law: hardswish(x) = x·relu6(x+3)/6.
name: hardswish_expand

law: softplus(x) = log1p(eˣ) at the default beta=1 — the exported bare spelling.
name: softplus_expand

law: log1p(eˣ) folds to softplus(x).
name: softplus_fold

law: elu(x) = x·[x>0] + (eˣ−1)·[x≤0] at the default α=1 — the where-spelled piecewise (XLA elu).
name: elu_expand

law: leaky_relu(x) = max(x, 0.01x) at the default slope 0.01.
name: leaky_relu_expand

law: softsign(x) = x/(|x|+1) — the bounded rational map's definition, expanded: the fused ATen kernel's denotation (composite-free — the kernel IS the manual spelling).
name: softsign_expand

law: max(u, 0) = relu(u).
name: relu_fold_max_r

law: max(0, u) = relu(u).
name: relu_fold_max_l

law: clamp_min(u, 0) = relu(u) — the exported spelling folds.
name: relu_fold_clamp

law: relu(u) = clamp_min(u, 0).
name: relu_expand

law: relu(relu(u)) = relu(u) — the projection is idempotent.

law: clamp(u, 0, 6) = relu6(u).
name: relu6_fold

law: relu6(u) = clamp(u, 0, 6).
name: relu6_expand

law: abs(abs(u)) = abs(u).
name: abs_idem

law: |u²| = u² — the square is already nonneg.
name: abs_square

law: (|u|)² = u² — abs is invisible to the square.
name: square_abs

law: √(u²) = |u| — the canonical spelling (NOT u — the negative branch keeps the abs).
name: sqrt_square

law: 1/√(u²) = 1/|u| — the rsqrt twin.
name: rsqrt_square

law: max(u, u) = u.
name: maximum_idem

law: min(u, u) = u.
name: minimum_idem

law: tanh is odd: tanh(−u) = −tanh(u).
name: tanh_neg

law: σ(−u) = 1 − σ(u) — the symmetric complement.

law: softsign is odd.
name: softsign_neg

law: erf is odd.
name: erf_neg

law: sin is odd.
name: sin_neg

law: cos is even: cos(−u) = cos(u).
name: cos_neg

law: e⁻ᵘ = 1/eᵘ.
name: exp_neg_recip

law: log(eᵘ) = u — eᵘ > 0 always, so the inverse is total.

law: log(1/u) = −log(u).

law: pow(u, 1) = u.

law: pow(u, 0) = ones(u) — IEEE-total including NaN bases (pow(nan,0)=1); spelled ones_like so the mint carries u's shape (the eval compare is shape-strict, not broadcast).

law: pow(u, 0.5) = sqrt(u) — the canonical square root.
name: pow_half

law: sqrt(u) = u^0.5 — the pow spelling (bridge to the pow family).
name: sqrt_to_pow

law: 1/(1/u) = u — reciprocal involution.
name: recip_recip

law: 1/u = reciprocal(u) — the div-spelled reciprocal folds.

law: reciprocal(u) = 1/u — the div spelling.

law: a + (−b) = a − b — the refold (sub_to_add's inverse).
name: add_neg_to_sub

law: u+u = 2u — the strength reduction.

law: 2u = u+u — the sharing direction.
name: mul2_to_add

law: −c folds to the negated Const leaf.

law: (u·c1)·c2 = u·(c1c2) — the scalar-factor fold (Inductor const-fold).
name: mul_const_assoc_0

law: (u·c1)·c2 = u·(c1c2) — the scalar-factor fold (Inductor const-fold).
name: mul_const_assoc_1

law: (u·c1)·c2 = u·(c1c2) — the scalar-factor fold (Inductor const-fold).
name: mul_const_assoc_2

law: (u·c1)·c2 = u·(c1c2) — the scalar-factor fold (Inductor const-fold).
name: mul_const_assoc_3

law: (u+c1)+c2 = u+(c1+c2) — the offset fold.

law: (u+c1)+c2 = u+(c1+c2) — the offset fold.

law: (u+c1)+c2 = u+(c1+c2) — the offset fold.

law: (u+c1)+c2 = u+(c1+c2) — the offset fold.

law: add(u, zeros_like(v)) = u — the spelled additive/multiplicative unit (grid-equality guard keeps it honest).

law: sub(u, zeros_like(v)) = u — the spelled additive/multiplicative unit (grid-equality guard keeps it honest).

law: div(u, ones_like(v)) = u — the spelled additive/multiplicative unit (grid-equality guard keeps it honest).

law: dropout(u, p, train=False) = u — the eval-mode strip (Inductor's aten.dropout elimination).

law: addcmul(t, a, b) = t + a·b — the fused op's spelled work (value=1 default).
